title: Effect of three substituted dihydroimidazole corrosion inhibitors on carbon steel surfaces: experimental and theoretical studies of inhibition and adsorption performance
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,39807-39831
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03853G, Paper

A. Marzaq, M. El Faydy, Daniil R. Bazanov, Natalia A. Lozinskaya, M. Maatallah, G. Kaichouh, M. Allali, L. Bazzi, A. Dafali, A. Zarrouk
MSPI achieves exceptional inhibitory efficacy of 99.12% in 1 M HCl. The three dihydroimidazoles act as mixed inhibitors with Langmuir adsorption. MD simulations confirm stable and parallel adsorption on the Fe(110) surface.
